brief:
Israeli occupation forces launched a series of raids and incursions across multiple towns, cities, and refugee camps scattered throughout the occupied West Bank on Saturday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The operations involved armed confrontations and gunfire as forces moved through residential areas.

During the raids, Israeli troops detained multiple Palestinians and carried out assaults on civilians in the communities targeted. The scale of the incursions spanned several locations across the West Bank, with clashes erupting between Israeli forces and Palestinians as the operations unfolded. Injuries were reported among those caught in the confrontations.
